correctness.rationale: The four eigenspaces have respective eigenvalues 0, (rs+1)b, b, b+sa and dimensions 1,1,r-1,r(s-1). Their exact projector diagonals yield two resolvent return functions. Since 2(I+hL/2)^(-1)-I has positive off-diagonals and each diagonal resolvent decreases strictly to 1/(rs+1), the smallest diagonal root determines the sharp horizon. The hub root is 2/[(rs-1)b]; at that root the leaf minus one half has sign exactly opposite to [(r(s-2)+1)(a/b)-r(rs-1)]. Both asymptotic regimes follow from rescaling this same positive unique root. Exact rational direct inversion checked at small parameter sets with 1,290 assertion groups; no finite evidence is used as an infinite proof.
